title: Can GenStone be used around fireplaces? - GenStone
text:
Can GenStone be used around fireplaces?

Yes. Many homeowners install GenStone panels to create fireplace surrounds and accent walls. Clearances and installation details should always follow the fireplace manufacturer’s recommendations and our rule of thumb: if you can place your hand on the installation surface for 5 seconds while the unit is running and no flames are embers will come in contact with the panels, you're good to go.
